 Order

Dated this the 10th day of July, 2025 Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.470 of 2019 registered at the Thodupuzha Police Station for offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 201 of IPC, now pending as C.C No.25 of 2020 on the files of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Thodupuzha.
The case originated which arose from a complaint filed by the 2nd respondent alleging commission of the offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act.
The petitioner's failure to appear in court, despite service of summons, has resulted in the issuance of non bailable warrant against him.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that his client's failure to appear in court was not willful and though desirous of surrendering in court, he is apprehensive that the bail application will not be considered on the same day.
3.
I heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

Considering the limited relief sought, the Crl.M.C. is disposed of with the following directions;
i) The petitioner shall surrender and move an application for bail before the jurisdictional court within two weeks with advance notice to the Public Prosecutor.
ii) If petitioner surrenders within the time granted, learned Magistrate shall pass orders on the application for bail on the day of surrender itself.
2025:KER:51037 iii) Execution of the non-bailable warrant pending against the petitioner shall be kept in abeyance for two weeks.
Sd/-
